classification: Diagnostic only. Not an accepted benchmark capture, replacement sample, performance comparison or adoption result.
launch: Use the existing pinned BenchmarkTool and its child file-descriptor protocol, original executable, original working directory, MallocNanoZone=0 and the prior allocator observation environment. No SwiftPM, rebuild, source change, lock change or changed benchmark metrics.

bounds.selection: Exactly the named fixed-palette workload; no broadening after results.

record: tool and executable hashes before and after
source and lock state before and after
matching PID/time crash reports when present

decisions.sameSignature: Stop immediately if objc_msgSend through CFPreferences and CGBitmapContextCreate/readRGBA8 recurs in warmup. Preserve evidence. Any hook-isolation experiment requires a separate frozen rule.
decisions.differentCrashOrTimeout: Stop and retain as a different or incomplete diagnostic outcome; do not retry within this probe.
decisions.threeCleanStarts: Record not reproduced. Keep the original study invalid and the cause unresolved; do not proceed to candidate captures or claim the instrumentation is repaired.
decisions.preconditionFailure: Stop before a run; do not silently rebuild, substitute a binary, change metrics or rescue the prior lock.

researchContext.limit: Neither source establishes the cause of the saved Aski crash.
